result: Reviewed human entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org on 2026-10-21. MB (P02144), myoglobin: monomeric haem protein of the muscle sarcoplasm that stores oxygen and facilitates its diffusion within muscle; reversibly binds oxygen through a pentacoordinated haem iron; has nitrite reductase activity. FMO3 (P31513): hepatic enzyme of the endoplasmic reticulum and microsomal membrane, cofactor FAD; trimethylamine + NADPH + O2 = trimethylamine N-oxide + NADP+ + H2O (EC 1.14.13.148); TMA is generated by gut microbiota from dietary precursors including L-carnitine; deficiency of FMO-mediated N-oxidation causes trimethylaminuria. CYP1A2 (P05177): hepatic cytochrome P450 of the endoplasmic reticulum, haem cofactor, using O2 and electrons from NADPH via cytochrome P450 reductase; catalyses the N-hydroxylation of heterocyclic amines. NAT2 (P11245): cytoplasmic; an N-hydroxyarylamine + acetyl-CoA = an N-acetoxyarylamine + CoA (EC 2.3.1.118); bioactivates several known carcinogens. SULT1A1 (P50225): cytoplasmic sulfotransferase using 3'-phosphoadenylyl sulfate; mediates the metabolic activation of carcinogenic N-hydroxyarylamines to reactive intermediates that form DNA adducts.
